name: BackPedal
description: London theft-recovery subscription for bikes and e-bikes. Mechanics install covert GSM/GPS/BLE trackers (17 disguised casings), a 24/7 in-house team recovers stolen bikes (company-stated ~80% recovery rate, ~48h typical), and backup theft insurance is underwritten by Sundays (FCA regulated). Annual protection from £153 (~£12.75/mo). Founded Sep 2021, UK.

mentions.evidence: ~$25,383 MRR, 372 active subscriptions, ~$59,307 L30 (upfront kit fees + renewals), ~$1,467,646 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~04:13 Warsaw (02:13 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Recovery-as-a-subscription for one high-theft asset in one city (e-bikes in Warsaw, cargo bikes, tools in vans, construction equipment). Partner with a licensed insurer for the backup cover and own the tracking + recovery ops.

whyItPrints: Hardware + ops + insurance wrapper sold as a subscription. Delivery riders and commuters can't afford to lose an e-bike, so they renew. Physical install and recovery ops are a moat no SaaS clone can copy overnight.
whyThisMatters:
A mechanic fits a hidden tracker to your bike in London, any day from 8am to 8pm. The kit is GSM, GPS, and Bluetooth, in one of 17 casings. The fitting is part of the subscription.

If the bike is stolen, you call a line staffed around the clock. They say an agent goes out the same hour and brings it back. The company puts the recovery rate above 80 percent, usually in about 48 hours. They still go if you left it unlocked. Clips on the site include Streatham in six hours and Brighton in two days.

If they can't recover it, Sundays provides backup insurance. They say that cover is FCA regulated. Customers they mention include commuters, racers, and delivery riders. It started in September 2021.
